subject: WL
title: Spanish 1B
description: Spanish 1B completes Spanish I, continuing directly from Spanish 1A and moving students from Novice Mid toward Novice High. Students order in restaurants, describe their homes and chores, shop for clothing, and begin narrating in the past with the preterite, then discuss vacations, community service, movies, and technology. New structures include venir, ser vs. estar, comparisons, stem-changing verbs, tú commands, the present progressive, demonstratives, direct and indirect object pronouns, gustar-like verbs, and saber vs. conocer. Together with Spanish 1A it prepares students for Spanish II in grade 9.
framework: 2019 California World Languages Standards; 2020 CA World Languages Framework (Novice Mid to Novice High)

standards.WL-COMM1-NM: Interpretive communication (Novice Mid): understand words, phrases, and some simple sentences in texts on familiar topics.
standards.WL-COMM2-NM: Interpersonal communication (Novice Mid): exchange information on familiar topics using practiced phrases and simple questions.
standards.WL-COMM3-NM: Presentational communication (Novice Mid): present information on familiar topics using practiced phrases and some simple sentences.
standards.WL-COMM1-NH: Interpretive communication (Novice High): understand and infer meaning from simple authentic oral, written, and signed texts on familiar topics.
standards.WL-COMM2-NH: Interpersonal communication (Novice High): exchange information in conversations on familiar topics using phrases and simple sentences, asking and answering questions.
standards.WL-COMM3-NH: Presentational communication (Novice High): present information on familiar topics using simple sentences in speaking and writing.
standards.WL-CULT1-NM: Cultures (Novice Mid): identify products and practices of Spanish-speaking cultures and compare them with one's own.
standards.WL-CULT1-NH: Cultures (Novice High): identify and describe products and practices of Spanish-speaking cultures and relate them to perspectives.
standards.WL-CULT2-NH: Intercultural interaction (Novice High): use culturally appropriate language and behavior in familiar everyday situations.
standards.WL-STRUC1-NM: Structures (Novice Mid): use agreement, comparisons, stem-changing verbs, commands, and the present progressive to communicate.
standards.WL-STRUC1-NH: Structures (Novice High): use the preterite, object pronouns, and gustar-like verbs to communicate at the Novice High level.
standards.WL-CONN1-NM: Connections (Novice Mid): use Spanish to reinforce knowledge of other disciplines such as math and geography.
standards.WL-CONN1-NH: Connections (Novice High): use Spanish to build knowledge in geography, history, and media literacy.

units.title: En el restaurante
units.big_idea: Dining out connects food, courtesy, and culture; ser vs. estar sharpens description.

units.title: Mi casa y los quehaceres
units.big_idea: Describing and comparing homes and chores introduces stem-changers, commands, and actions in progress.

units.title: La ropa y las compras
units.big_idea: Shopping requires preferences, prices, and pointing things out, in stores and markets.

units.title: ¿Qué compraste? The Preterite Begins
units.big_idea: The preterite lets us tell what we did; object pronouns make speech efficient.

units.title: De vacaciones
units.big_idea: Narrating trips uses the full regular preterite plus ir and ser, while geography shapes culture.

units.title: Ayudamos en la comunidad
units.big_idea: Communities thrive when people help one another; we tell who did what for whom.

units.title: El cine y la televisión
units.big_idea: Media reflects culture, and gustar-like verbs express reactions.

units.title: La tecnología
units.big_idea: Technology shapes how teens communicate everywhere; saber and conocer express knowledge.

units.title: Repaso de Español I y evaluación final
units.big_idea: We show Novice High proficiency and get ready for Spanish II.

weeks.topic: ¿Qué tal el verano? Diagnostic and restaurant vocabulary
objectives: Reactivate Spanish 1A skills in a new context
Name table items and restaurant foods

days.title: Diagnostic
days.work: Hold a 3-minute conversation with a parent about your summer, family, and likes, then take a short 1A diagnostic quiz to find gaps to target.

days.title: Table setting
days.work: Learn 12 table-setting words and set the table while naming each item aloud: Pongo el tenedor a la izquierda.

days.title: Restaurant foods
days.work: Learn main dishes, desserts, and drinks (el bistec, el arroz, el flan) and build a three-course menu.

days.title: Polite requests
days.work: Learn me trae..., ¿me puede traer...?, ¿algo más?, la cuenta por favor and practice with a parent as camarero.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a restaurant vocabulary quiz and review the diagnostic results to set two personal goals.

weeks.assessment: Restaurant vocabulary quiz and diagnostic conversation.

weeks.topic: The verb venir and describing a meal
objectives: Describe dishes and who comes to dinner

days.title: Venir
days.work: Learn the forms of venir (vengo, vienes, viene, venimos, venís, vienen) and complete a Conjuguemos drill to 90%.

days.title: ¿Quién viene?
days.work: Write invitations for a family dinner and sentences stating who comes, when, and from where.

days.title: Taste words
days.work: Learn delicioso, picante, salado, dulce, rico and describe five foods during a real meal.

days.title: Listening
days.work: Watch a restaurant scene video in Spanish and list what each customer orders and how they describe it.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a venir and food description quiz.

objectives: Distinguish permanent traits from conditions and location
Use ser and estar correctly in context

days.title: Rules
days.work: Learn the DOCTOR (ser) and PLACE (estar) memory aids and sort 20 sentence cards.

days.title: Meaning changes
days.work: Study adjectives that change meaning (es aburrido vs. está aburrido; es rico vs. está rico) and write 6 contrasting pairs.

days.title: Food & feelings
days.work: Describe a meal: how the food is (ser) and how it tastes and is today (estar), plus how diners feel.

days.title: StudySpanish practice
days.work: Read the StudySpanish.com ser/estar lesson and complete its practice exercises.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a 25-item ser vs. estar quiz.

objectives: Order a full meal in a role-play
materials: printed authentic menu from a Spanish or Mexican restaurant

days.title: Culture: comer fuera
days.work: Read about tapas in Spain, comida corrida in Mexico, and sobremesa, and compare meal times with yours.

days.title: Authentic menu
days.work: Read a printed authentic Spanish-language menu and answer 10 questions about dishes and prices.

days.title: Role-play prep
days.work: Write cue cards for a restaurant role-play using usted, polite requests, and venir.

days.title: Role-play
days.work: Perform the restaurant role-play with a parent from arrival to paying la cuenta.

days.title: Unit 1 test
days.work: Take the unit test: restaurant listening, menu reading, venir, and ser vs. estar.

weeks.assessment: Restaurant role-play rubric and unit 1 test.

days.title: Rooms
days.work: Learn 10 rooms and draw and label a floor plan of your home.

days.title: Furniture
days.work: Learn 15 furniture items and label your bedroom with sticky notes.

days.title: Colors
days.work: Learn color words with agreement (rojo/roja, azul, marrón) and describe the colors of 10 items in your room.

days.title: Mi dormitorio
days.work: Write a 10-sentence description of your bedroom using hay, estar + prepositions, and colors.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a house vocabulary quiz.

materials: photos of rooms or real-estate ads

days.title: Comparatives
days.work: Learn más/menos...que and tan...como and compare 10 pairs of objects in your house.

days.title: Irregulars
days.work: Learn mejor, peor, mayor, menor and compare family members' ages and skills.

days.title: Superlatives
days.work: Learn el/la más... de and write superlatives about your family, house, and town.

days.title: Real-estate ads
days.work: Read three Spanish apartment ads and compare them in eight sentences, choosing the best for your family.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a comparisons quiz.

objectives: Conjugate poder, dormir, costar, and jugar

days.title: The boot
days.work: Learn the stem-change 'boot' pattern and conjugate poder and dormir, noting nosotros/vosotros don't change.

days.title: More verbs
days.work: Add costar, volver, encontrar, almorzar, and jugar (u→ue) and complete a Conjuguemos stem-changer drill.

days.title: Sleep survey
days.work: Ask family ¿Cuántas horas duermes? and ¿A qué hora vuelves a casa? and graph the results.

days.title: Puedo...
days.work: Write 10 sentences about what you can and cannot do in your house using poder + infinitive.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take an o→ue stem-changer quiz.

weeks.topic: Los quehaceres and affirmative tú commands

days.title: Chores
days.work: Learn 14 chores and make a family chore chart in Spanish.

days.title: Regular tú commands
days.work: Learn that the affirmative tú command equals the él form (limpia, lava, come) and write commands for each chore.

days.title: Irregular commands
days.work: Learn di, haz, ve, pon, sal, sé, ten, ven and complete a 20-item command practice.

days.title: Simón dice
days.work: Play Simón dice with a family member using 20 commands, then actually do three chores as commanded.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a chores and commands quiz.

days.title: Present progressive
days.work: Learn estar + -ando/-iendo, including leyendo and durmiendo, and describe what each family member is doing right now.

days.title: Picture description
days.work: Describe a busy house illustration in 10 progressive sentences.

days.title: Culture: casas
days.work: Read about homes in Spain and Latin America (interior patios, rooftop azoteas, apartment living) and write five comparisons.

days.title: Home tour
days.work: Record a 2-minute Spanish video tour of your home with comparisons and chores done in each room.

days.title: Unit 2 test
days.work: Take the unit test on house vocabulary, comparisons, stem-changers, commands, and the progressive.

weeks.assessment: Home tour video rubric and unit 2 test.

objectives: Describe what people wear for different weather

days.title: Clothing
days.work: Learn 20 clothing words and label clothes from your closet.

days.title: Llevar
days.work: Describe what five family members are wearing today with llevar and colors.

days.title: Weather & clothes
days.work: Connect weather and seasons to clothing: Cuando hace frío, llevo un abrigo; write 8 sentences.

days.title: Fashion blog
days.work: Read a short teen fashion blog post in Spanish and list the items and opinions mentioned.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a clothing vocabulary quiz with a listening description.

weeks.topic: Stem-changing e→ie verbs: pensar, querer, preferir
objectives: Express preferences and intentions about clothes

days.title: e→ie
days.work: Learn pensar, querer, preferir, empezar, entender, cerrar in the boot pattern and complete a Conjuguemos drill.

days.title: Preferences
days.work: Write 10 sentences comparing clothing choices: Prefiero la camisa roja, pero mi hermano quiere la azul.

days.title: Pensar + inf
days.work: Use pensar + infinitive to describe three upcoming plans and compare with ir a + infinitive.

days.title: Conversation
days.work: Discuss with a parent what clothes you want, prefer, and plan to buy for the next season.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take an e→ie quiz with mixed o→ue items.

days.title: Demonstratives
days.work: Learn este, ese, aquel and their forms and point out clothing at three distances in 12 sentences.

days.title: Big numbers
days.work: Learn 100–1,000,000 including doscientos/quinientos/setecientos and read 20 prices aloud.

days.title: Currencies
days.work: Learn the currencies of eight Spanish-speaking countries and convert three clothing prices to dollars.

days.title: ¿Cuánto cuesta?
days.work: Practice ¿Cuánto cuesta(n)? and answer with prices and demonstratives using price-tagged items at home.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a demonstratives and numbers dictation quiz.

weeks.topic: De compras: shopping role-plays and culture
objectives: Shop for clothing in a store or market

days.title: Store phrases
days.work: Learn ¿En qué puedo servirle?, ¿Qué talla usa?, Me queda grande/bien, and practice a fitting-room dialogue.

days.title: Markets
days.work: Read about markets such as Chichicastenango (Guatemala) and El Rastro (Madrid) and when bargaining is appropriate.

days.title: Textiles
days.work: Watch a short video on Guatemalan Maya weaving (huipiles) and write five sentences about the product and its meaning.

days.title: Role-play
days.work: Role-play buying an outfit in a store and then bargaining for a souvenir in a market with play money.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a shopping-dialogue listening quiz.

weeks.assessment: Shopping role-play rubric and listening quiz.

days.title: Design
days.work: Design a catalog page with eight items, colors, sizes, and prices in euros or pesos.

days.title: Write
days.work: Write a description for each item using demonstratives, comparisons, and e→ie verbs.

days.title: Reading
days.work: Read an authentic online store page in Spanish and answer comprehension questions.

days.title: Present
days.work: Present your catalog as a 90-second TV shopping segment.

days.title: Unit 3 test
days.work: Take the unit 3 test on clothing, stem-changers, demonstratives, numbers, and shopping.

weeks.assessment: Catalog project rubric and unit 3 test.

objectives: Narrate completed past actions with -ar verbs

days.title: Preterite -ar
days.work: Learn the preterite -ar endings (-é, -aste, -ó, -amos, -asteis, -aron) and conjugate comprar, hablar, and mirar.

days.title: Time expressions
days.work: Learn ayer, anoche, la semana pasada, hace dos días and write 10 sentences about last weekend.

days.title: Present vs. preterite
days.work: Contrast nosotros forms (hablamos) and identify present or past from context in 15 sentences.

days.title: Receipts
days.work: Look at three store receipts and write what each person bought and how much they paid.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a preterite -ar quiz.

days.title: Spelling rules
days.work: Learn why buscar→busqué, pagar→pagué, empezar→empecé and practice 15 yo forms.

days.title: StudySpanish practice
days.work: Complete the StudySpanish.com preterite regular-verb exercises and correct errors.

days.title: Diary
days.work: Write a 10-sentence diary entry about a shopping trip using at least five spelling-change verbs.

days.title: Interview
days.work: Ask a family member ten questions about what they did yesterday and record their answers in the preterite.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a spelling-change preterite quiz.

weeks.topic: Direct object pronouns lo, la, los, las

days.title: DOPs
days.work: Learn lo/la/los/las and replace the object in 15 sentences: Compré la camisa → La compré.

days.title: Placement
days.work: Practice pronoun placement before conjugated verbs and attached to infinitives and progressives.

days.title: ¿Lo compraste?
days.work: Answer a parent's questions about purchases using pronouns: ¿Compraste los zapatos? Sí, los compré.

days.title: Gift story
days.work: Write a short story about buying gifts for three relatives using preterite and direct object pronouns.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a direct object pronoun quiz.

days.title: Review: units 1–2
days.work: Review restaurant phrases, venir, ser/estar, house, comparisons, stem-changers, commands, and the progressive with a practice test.

days.title: Review: units 3–4
days.work: Review clothing, e→ie verbs, demonstratives, numbers, preterite -ar, and direct object pronouns with Conjuguemos drills.

days.title: Speaking exam
days.work: Do a 4-minute interview with a parent about your home, routine chores, clothes, and a recent shopping trip.

days.title: Written exam
days.work: Take the semester exam with listening, reading, grammar, and a 12-sentence writing prompt.

days.title: Reflection
days.work: Complete a can-do checklist and set two goals for semester 2.

days.title: Vacation words
days.work: Learn 20 vacation places and activities and caption your own travel photos.

days.title: Preterite -ar review
days.work: Write 10 sentences about a past trip using -ar preterite verbs (visité, nadé, tomé).

days.title: Travel brochure
days.work: Read a Spanish tourism brochure for Puerto Rico and list five attractions with descriptions.

days.title: Dream trip
days.work: Choose a Spanish-speaking destination and list ten activities you could do there.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a vacation vocabulary quiz.

days.title: Endings
days.work: Learn the shared -er/-ir preterite endings (-í, -iste, -ió, -imos, -isteis, -ieron) and conjugate comer and salir.

days.title: Drill
days.work: Complete a Conjuguemos preterite -er/-ir drill to 90%.

days.title: Leer and oír
days.work: Learn the y-forms (leyó, leyeron, oyó) and write five sentences with them.

days.title: Trip interview
days.work: Interview a parent about their best vacation using -ar, -er, and -ir preterite questions.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a mixed regular preterite quiz.

objectives: Use fui, fuiste, fue in context
Describe where you went and how it was

days.title: Ir/ser preterite
days.work: Learn that ir and ser share preterite forms and determine meaning from context in 15 sentences.

days.title: ¿Adónde fuiste?
days.work: Write where each family member went last summer and how it was: Fuimos a la playa; fue divertido.

days.title: Listening
days.work: Listen to a native speaker describe a trip (Spanish Proficiency Exercises) and note where they went and what they did.

days.title: Conversation
days.work: Have an unscripted conversation with a parent about a past trip, asking at least five follow-up questions.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take an ir/ser preterite quiz.

weeks.assessment: Ir/ser preterite quiz and conversation rubric.

days.title: Geography
days.work: Locate eight famous sites (Machu Picchu, Chichén Itzá, Salar de Uyuni, El Yunque, la Alhambra) and identify their landforms.

days.title: Reading
days.work: Read an article in Spanish about Machu Picchu and answer comprehension questions.

days.title: Research
days.work: Research one destination's history, landforms, food, and festivals and take notes in Spanish.

days.title: Comparación
days.work: Compare your destination with a California landmark (Yosemite, Death Valley) in six sentences.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Share research findings orally in a 1-minute summary.

weeks.assessment: Research notes check and oral summary.

objectives: Narrate a trip in the past

days.title: Sequencing
days.work: Learn primero, luego, después, más tarde, por fin and outline a trip story.

days.title: Draft
days.work: Write a 15-sentence travel blog about a real or imagined trip to your researched destination using the preterite.

days.title: Revise
days.work: Self-edit with a checklist (preterite endings, ir/ser, -car/-gar/-zar) and add photos.

days.title: Share
days.work: Present your blog aloud and answer three questions from a listener.

days.title: Unit 5 test
days.work: Take the unit 5 test on vacation vocabulary and the preterite.

weeks.assessment: Travel blog rubric and unit 5 test.

days.title: Vocabulary
days.work: Learn 18 community-service words and match them to photos of volunteer work.

days.title: Local needs
days.work: List community organizations in your town and describe in Spanish what each one does.

days.title: Reading
days.work: Read a short article about a youth volunteer project in Latin America and summarize it in five sentences.

days.title: Survey
days.work: Ask family members what volunteer work they have done and record answers in the preterite.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a community vocabulary quiz.

weeks.topic: Indirect object pronouns and the verb dar
objectives: Use me, te, le, nos, les
Say who gives what to whom

days.title: IOPs
days.work: Learn indirect object pronouns and identify the indirect object in 15 sentences.

days.title: Dar
days.work: Learn present dar (doy, das...) and preterite dar (di, diste, dio) and complete a drill.

days.title: Le/les clarification
days.work: Practice clarifying le/les with a + person: Le di la ropa a mi abuela.

days.title: Gifts and help
days.work: Write 10 sentences about what you gave or did for others using IOPs.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take an indirect object pronoun and dar quiz.

objectives: Conjugate hacer and decir in the preterite
Report what people did and said

days.title: Hacer
days.work: Learn hice, hiciste, hizo (z spelling), hicimos, hicieron and answer ¿Qué hiciste ayer? in 8 ways.

days.title: Decir
days.work: Learn dije, dijiste, dijo, dijimos, dijeron and report what five people said using IOPs: Me dijo que...

days.title: Practice
days.work: Complete StudySpanish.com irregular preterite practice for hacer and decir.

days.title: Culture: service
days.work: Read about César Chávez and Dolores Huerta's community organizing in California and write five preterite sentences about what they did.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take an irregular preterite quiz.

objectives: Plan and report on a service project
materials: materials for a small service project

days.title: Plan
days.work: Plan a small service activity (food drive, letters to seniors, park cleanup) and write the plan in Spanish.

days.title: Do it
days.work: Carry out the service activity with family and take photos.

days.title: Write
days.work: Write a 12-sentence report in the preterite on what you did, what people said, and what you gave.

days.title: Present
days.work: Present the report with photos to a family audience and answer questions.

days.title: Unit 6 test
days.work: Take the unit 6 test on IOPs, dar, hacer, decir, and community vocabulary.

weeks.assessment: Service report rubric and unit 6 test.

objectives: Give opinions about shows and movies

days.title: Genres
days.work: Learn 12 genre words and classify 15 well-known movies and shows.

days.title: Opinions
days.work: Give opinions with me parece, creo que, and adjectives like emocionante, violento, tonto.

days.title: TV listings
days.work: Read a Spanish-language TV guide and answer questions about times, channels, and genres.

days.title: Telenovelas
days.work: Read about the telenovela tradition in Mexico and Colombia and compare it with U.S. TV dramas.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a genre vocabulary and opinions quiz.

weeks.topic: Acabar de + infinitive and verbs like gustar
objectives: Use aburrir, interesar, encantar, importar, quedar, faltar

days.title: Acabar de
days.work: Learn acabar de + infinitive and write 8 sentences about things you just did.

days.title: Gustar-like verbs
days.work: Learn me aburre(n), me interesa(n), me encanta(n), me importa(n), me falta(n) and write opinions about movies.

days.title: Señor Wooly
days.work: Watch a free Señor Wooly video and describe what the characters like, bore, or interest them.

days.title: Conversation
days.work: Discuss favorite movies and shows with a parent using five gustar-like verbs.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a gustar-like verbs quiz.

objectives: Write and present a film review
Summarize a plot in the preterite
materials: a family film with Spanish audio or subtitles

days.title: Watch
days.work: Watch a family film with Spanish audio (e.g., Coco) with Spanish subtitles and take notes on characters.

days.title: Plot summary
days.work: Write a 10-sentence plot summary in the preterite.

days.title: Review
days.work: Add opinions with gustar-like verbs and a star rating to complete a film review.

days.title: Present
days.work: Record your film review as a 2-minute video.

days.title: Unit 7 test
days.work: Take the unit 7 test on media vocabulary, acabar de, and gustar-like verbs.

weeks.assessment: Film review rubric and unit 7 test.

days.title: Tech vocabulary
days.work: Learn 18 technology words and label the parts of a computer and phone.

days.title: Pedir & servir
days.work: Learn the e→i boot pattern (pido, sirve) and complete a Conjuguemos drill, including preterite pidió/sirvió.

days.title: ¿Para qué sirve?
days.work: Explain what 8 devices or apps are for: La computadora sirve para escribir.

days.title: Survey
days.work: Survey family about daily screen use and write a report with numbers.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a technology vocabulary and e→i verb quiz.

objectives: Talk about skills and people/places you know

days.title: Rules
days.work: Learn saber (facts, how to) vs. conocer (people, places) and the personal a, then sort 20 sentences.

days.title: Sé + infinitive
days.work: Write 10 sentences about tech skills you know how to do: Sé crear una página web.

days.title: Conozco
days.work: Write about people and places you know, including the personal a.

days.title: Interview
days.work: Interview a parent about their tech skills and places they know, using both verbs.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a saber vs. conocer quiz.

days.title: Infographic
days.work: Read a Spanish infographic on teen internet use in Spain or Mexico and answer questions about the data.

days.title: Comparison
days.work: Compare those statistics with U.S. teen data in six Spanish sentences.

days.title: Opinion
days.work: Write a 10-sentence opinion piece on ventajas y desventajas of phones for teens.

days.title: Debate
days.work: Hold a short debate with a parent using en mi opinión and estoy/no estoy de acuerdo.

days.title: Unit 8 test
days.work: Take the unit 8 test on technology vocabulary, pedir/servir, and saber/conocer.

weeks.assessment: Opinion piece rubric and unit 8 test.

weeks.topic: Spanish I review: present tense system
objectives: Review all Spanish I present-tense structures

days.title: Regular present
days.work: Review regular -ar/-er/-ir verbs from 1A with a timed Conjuguemos drill.

days.title: Irregular & stem-changers
days.work: Review ser, estar, ir, tener, venir and o→ue, e→ie, e→i stem-changers.

days.title: Commands & progressive
days.work: Review tú commands and the present progressive with a picture-description task.

days.title: Pronouns
days.work: Review direct and indirect object pronouns in a 20-item practice.

days.title: Practice test
days.work: Take a self-scored present-tense practice test and list your weakest areas.

weeks.topic: Spanish I review: past tense and culture
objectives: Review the preterite and cultural topics

days.title: Regular preterite
days.work: Review regular and spelling-change preterite verbs with a narrative writing task.

days.title: Irregular preterite
days.work: Review ir/ser, hacer, decir, and dar in the preterite with a story-retelling activity.

days.title: Culture review
days.work: Review the year's culture topics (tapas, homes, markets, destinations, telenovelas) with a self-made quiz.

days.title: Reading practice
days.work: Read two authentic texts (a blog post and an ad) and answer questions.

days.title: Speaking practice
days.work: Practice a mock 5-minute conversation covering all year's topics.

weeks.topic: Spanish I final integrated performance assessment
objectives: Demonstrate Novice High proficiency in all three modes

days.title: Interpretive
days.work: Read an authentic text and listen to a native-speaker clip, answering comprehension and inference questions.

days.title: Interpersonal
days.work: Hold a 5-minute unscripted conversation about home, shopping, a past trip, and technology.

days.title: Presentational writing
days.work: Write a 15–20 sentence narrative about a memorable day using present and preterite.

days.title: Presentational speaking
days.work: Present a 2-minute cultural comparison from the year.

days.title: Reflection
days.work: Complete the Spanish I can-do self-assessment and set goals for Spanish II.

weeks.assessment: Integrated performance assessment rubric; completion of Spanish I.
